annotations.title: Give a workflow its steps diagram

description: Returns the Napkin diagram that holds a WORKFLOW page's steps, creating it when the page has none. If the page body has a ```mermaid block, it moves into the diagram verbatim (node ids kept, so changes anchored to a step still point at it) and leaves the body. Then edit the steps with napkin_diagrams_update using the returned diagramId. One diagram per workflow holds every step anyone has described — when two people describe the same process differently, add the steps to this one diagram rather than making a second. A step that is itself a workflow is a node whose meta ref is { type: 'page', id: <that workflow's page id> }. compass_pages_get returns processDiagramId when one exists. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response, after the user has approved. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
